content.text:
I removed one visible flaw from the home page, but I'm not sure it's the one you meant. The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't see what the last change was.

The flaw was the hero's `border-bottom`, which ran straight through the middle of the three stat cards, since the cards overlap the hero by 56px. I deleted that border in `site/css/pages.css`. The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't re-render the page after the edit, so I haven't looked at the result.

At 1280px and 400px wide, nothing else looked broken to me. If you meant something else, such as spacing, the hero image or the stat cards' shadow, tell me what looks wrong and I'll fix that.

STATUS: DONE
